items.text:
Sol.278.(a) Cause -someone or something  that  makes  something  else happen. Upshot -  something  that  happens  as  a result of other actions, events or decisions. Blame -  to  think  or  say  that  a  certain person or thing is responsible for something bad that has happened. Estimate -  a  guess  or  judgement  about something.
Sol.279.(d)  mild - not severe, serious, or harsh. Vociferous - expressing your opinions or feelings in a loud and confident way. Assertive - confident and able to express oneself clearly . Biased - unfairly prejudiced for or against someone or something. Political -  relating  to  public  affairs  of  a country.
Sol.280.(c) Propitious -indicating a good chance of success. Adverse  having  a  negative  or  harmful effect on something. Striking -interesting and unusual enough to attract attraction. Critical tending to point out errors. Listless lacking energy or enthusiasm.

Sol.281.(b) Strict -(of a person) following rules or beliefs exactly. Lenient  not  as  severe  or  strong  in punishment  or  judgment  as  would  be expected. Kind  generous, helpful  and  thinking about other people's feelings. Rude impolite and disrespectful. Rowdy noisy and disorderly.
Sol.282.(b) Clean - that is not dirty Contaminate -  make  something  impure by  addition  of  a  poisonous  or  polluting substance. Rug -  a  soft  piece  of  material  used  to cover the floor.
Sol.283.(a) Fastidious very attentive to detail. Lax not strict or severe. Late  occurring  after  the  expected  or usual time. Scrupulous  diligent  and  thorough  in carrying out tasks. Speedy  moving  or  capable  of  moving quickly.
Sol.284.(a) Lazy unwilling to work or use energy. Industrious diligent and hard-working. Dizzy -having a feeling  of  spinning around and being unable to balance. Skittish -(of people and animals) nervous or easily frightened. Exhausting making you feel very tired.

Sol.285.(d)  Non-combustible -  not  able to burn easily. Flammable able to burn easily. Fire-resistant -totally  or  almost  totally unburnable. Incendiary -(of a device or attack) designed to cause fires. Nonexplosive - not able to explode easily.
Sol.286.(c)  Refusal  the  act  of  saying that you will not do or accept something. Consent  permission  for  something  to happen. Knowledge -information and understanding that you have in your mind. Approval  the  feeling that something is good or  acceptable.
Sol.287.(a) Profane showing disrespect toward sacred things. Sacred regarded with great respect and reverence. Grave serious or solemn in manner. Narrow limited in width or scope. Holy  dedicated  to  religious or spiritual purposes.
Sol.288.(d) Charitable -generous in giving to those in need. Hard firm and solid in texture. Relaxed free from tension or anxiety. Tolerant willing to accept others' beliefs or behaviors. Clement mild or merciful.
